#### About Us

## Technology enables digital transformation. Our expertise ensures it.

## About Harmony Healthcare IT

Every technology transition eventually leads to the same question: **_What’s the right strategy for the data?_**

Harmony Healthcare IT helps healthcare organizations answer that question throughout their modernization journey, whether they’re [migrating to new systems](https://www.harmonyhit.com/services/migration-conversion/), retiring applications, scaling application rationalization efforts, or managing multiple initiatives simultaneously.

With experience spanning 715+ unique software brands, 550 successful customer engagements, and more than two decades in healthcare data management, our [repeatable and scalable methodology](https://www.harmonyhit.com/our-process/) helps organizations [navigate complex data initiatives with greater confidence.](https://www.harmonyhit.com/why-choose-harmony/)

The result? A trusted data partner that brings proven expertise to every engagement, delivering complete and validated data, faster time to value, and successful execution time and again.

### **Our Areas of Expertise**

- Data Extraction & Retrieval
- Data Migrations & Conversions
- Legacy Data Archiving & Integrations
- And other Healthcare Data Modernization Initiatives

### **Supporting clinical, financial, and operational data across:**

- EHRs
- ERPs
- Revenue Cycle Systems
- Document Management Systems
- Laboratory & Pathology Systems
- Enterprise Applications
- Legacy Data Archives

## Deep Experience. Exceptional Results.

#### We support health data management initiatives across the full data lifecycle, simplifying execution, reducing cost and risk, and transforming historical information into a strategic asset that you can trust, access, and activate to support continuity of care, operational excellence, and data-driven innovation.

#### Expertise

Expertise across 715+ unique software brands.

#### Quality

550+ successful engagements, KLAS-ranked top 3 archiving vendor

#### ROI

Most customers save $500,000+ annually, achieve 2-3X ROI over time.

#### Security

HITRUST Certified, 560+ controls, 24/7 endpoint monitoring.

## Transforming Data. Elevating Care.

Our mission is to help healthcare organizations in the U.S., Canada, and beyond successfully navigate complex health data management initiatives. Through proven expertise and execution, we support continuity of care, operational excellence, and data-driven innovation across the full data lifecycle.

We’re proud to be recognized by KLAS excelling in [high-complexity projects](https://www.harmonyhit.com/harmony-healthcare-it-recognized-for-success-with-large-and-complex-legacy-data-projects-in-klas-data-archiving-2024-report/), reflecting our ability to support the largest organizations with the most challenging initiatives.

## Delivering Complete, Validated, and Trusted Data.

We focus exclusively on the healthcare industry, helping organizations navigate complex modernization and data management initiatives with confidence, from migrations and archiving to technology consolidation and M&A-related data needs.

Because data is only valuable when it can be trusted, we place validation, integrity, and accessibility at the center of every engagement. The result is complete, validated, and reliable data that supports continuity of care, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and data-driven innovation.

Powered by our proven methodology and the [HealthData Platform™,](https://www.harmonyhit.com/products/health-data-platform/) we help healthcare organizations simplify complex data initiatives and accelerate time to value.
